Dominik Bošnjak is a contributor from Croatia. He has been writing about games for as long as he can remember and began doing so professionally in 2010 because an opportunity presented itself while he was pursuing a degree in journalism. Before GameRant, Dominik worked as a journalist, editor, and video editor for over half a dozen outlets spanning two continents, covering video games, technology, and entertainment. He has bylines at IGN Adria, SamMobile, Android Headlines, Spilled, HCL, 24sata, and VIDI, among others. If he was forced to pick a favorite game genre, he'd go with RPGs, but he wasn't, so he didn't.
In no particular order: Gothic 1 and 2, Fallout 2 and New Vegas, Persona 3-5, Disco Elysium, Sekiro, TES 3: Morrowind, XCOM 2, Fire Emblem: Three Houses, Cyberpunk 2077, The Witcher 3, Hitman: Blood Money, GTA: San Andreas, Hotline Miami, Splinter Cell 1-3, MGS3, Sid Meier's Pirates (the remake), Star Wars: KOTOR, The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, Assassin's Creed 2, NFS: Underground 2, S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat.
Picking just one is impossible, but beating Sekiro Charmless with Demon Bell on a fresh New Game run is certainly up there; that run only took a year! Getting into top 500 Hearthstone EU players in 2015 was another memorable moment for me. In terms of literal achievements, unlocking Persona 4 Golden's Hardcore Risette Fan trophy comes to mind, because it required pouring over spreadsheets for hours on end.
Dominik covers a wide variety of gaming industry topics, including development updates, financial reports, and labor issues. He also keeps a close eye on game subscription service libraries, cataloging any changes to them.
PlayStation Will Continue Supporting Physical Games After 2028
Fallout 76 marks another major milestone as Bethesda looks back on its steady growth and previews what is next for the open-world RPG.
The EA Play Pro catalog is leaving nine games behind in December 2026, including several that have been available for over eight years.
Bethesda offers a detailed look at major Fallout 76 additions planned for December 2026 and spring 2027, all of which are now testable.
The Gilded Age Season 4 has eight episodes airing weekly through December 2026, closely mimicking its Season 2 calendar from 2023.
A retailer gaffe prematurely reveals a massive LEGO set that is expected to launch in November as one of the toymaker's largest 2026 models.
Nintendo releases a surprise Direct just ahead of November 2026, giving fans another product presentation with almost no prior notice.
PlayStation Plus subscribers across every membership tier have three more days to take advantage of a limited-time Halloween discount.
Xbox Game Pass is undergoing a large exodus later today, with a varied assortment of nine titles leaving just ahead of November 2026.
Owners of 40th Anniversary Edition Switch 2 consoles should take one short but crucial step before starting to use their new handhelds.
The first Call of Duty on Nintendo hardware in over a decade reportedly has some non-trivial performance issues on the Switch 2, but it's not all bad.
Two games released in 2019 and 2021 are getting delisted from the PlayStation 5 and a handful of other platforms on December 31.
Diablo 4 players can once again jump into a limited-time Halloween event, this time in exchange for some unique (and not fully disclosed) rewards.
Xbox Game Pass rounds out October 2026 with an uncharacteristically large wave featuring four new games, including a day-one title.
More than eight years after announcing TES 6, Bethesda is reportedly finally ready to share more about the game, including its newly leaked title.
The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition Nintendo Switch 2 console is now officially out, but supplies are unlikely to last for long.
A charming life sim that's likely to appeal to Stardew Valley fans locks down a January 2027 release date for PC, consoles, and Xbox Game Pass.
FromSoftware officially confirms what many fans already assumed was the case: its Switch 2 exclusive The Duskbloods is getting a big delay.
With three weeks until GTA 6 releases, Rockstar reveals a dozen new screenshots from its much-anticipated game, together with gameplay details.
Minecraft receives an absolutely massive update even by its own standards, introducing new content and more than 600 fixes, among other additions.
A crucial Rockstar Games union vote is announced for November 2026, having been scheduled for an important Grand Theft Auto 6 date.
